lines.en: Three steps, then I stop.

lines.zh: 我到那个位置就停下来。
lines.en: I stop at that exact spot.
My steps are very even.
You move; I find a new place to stand.
I shift from the tree to the door.

lines.zh: 我的位置总在你视线边缘。
lines.en: I stay at the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 我走过来，只为看你一眼。
lines.en: I walk over just to look at you.

lines.zh: 走到这儿，正好能看清你。
lines.en: From here I see you clearly.
My steps are light as if never made.
I do not approach. I change angles.

lines.zh: 我从你的左边移到右边。
lines.en: I move from your left to your right.
I cover this ground slowly.
The wind lifts my hem; I do not move.
I do nothing but look.
Carry on. I will not disturb you.
I stood the whole afternoon.
The pose holds. I do not tire.
I count how often you bend.
I do not speak. Speaking would break it.
Look back. I have not shifted.
By the field, I stand like a post.

lines.zh: 静着的时候，风吹不动我。
lines.en: Still, and the wind will not move me.

lines.zh: 我的视线落在你握锄头的手。
lines.en: My gaze rests on the hand holding your hoe.
When you finish, I am still there.
I wait for you to get used to me.
I hold still. So do you.
I am right there, watching.
No need to search. I have been here.
We have looked at each other a long while.

lines.zh: 你眨了几次眼，我都数了。
lines.en: I counted every blink.

lines.zh: 你身后那棵树，我在树下。
lines.en: The tree behind you. I am beneath it.

lines.zh: 你的每个动作我都记着。
lines.en: I keep every move you make.
I stay unless you leave.

lines.zh: 别装没看见，我知道你看见了。
lines.en: Do not pretend. You saw me.
You cannot make out my face, can you?

lines.zh: 我从没靠近，也从没走远。
lines.en: Never closer, never farther.
Why do you keep glancing this way?
Your hands shake. I only watch.
The distance has not changed.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，直到你回头。
lines.en: I stand here until you look back.
You cannot shake these eyes.

lines.zh: 我站在你每天都会经过的地方。
lines.en: I stand where you pass each day.

lines.zh: 你已经习惯我在那儿了。
lines.en: You have grown used to me there.
I do not smile. I do not leave.

lines.zh: 你在猜我下一步，我也是。
lines.en: You guess my next move. I guess yours.
When I have seen enough, I vanish.
Struck, and my pose holds.
One step back, then still.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方凉了一下。
lines.en: The spot you hit goes cold.
I do not cry out. I watch.
This does not stop me watching.
I haven't moved — only watched you.
You see me standing again.
A layer of dust falls off me.
Your hand will go numb from that.
I remain where I stood.

lines.zh: 你举着东西，我还是看着。
lines.en: You hold something up. I keep watching.
I do not eat. I do not reach.

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，我就看着它。
lines.en: Set it down and I will watch it instead.

lines.zh: 这不会让我离开这个位置。
lines.en: That will not move me from this spot.
Your arm will tire holding that.
Food does not interest me.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，我还看着。
lines.en: Turn away; I am still watching.
Lift the lamp. I do not move.
Do not try to lure me off.
I only look. I do not take.
You bumped in. I did not yield.

lines.zh: 我就在这儿，你早该看见。
lines.en: I have been here. You should have looked.
One bump, and I still stand.
You pull back; my pose holds.

lines.zh: 我的身体比看上去的沉。
lines.en: I am heavier than I look.

lines.zh: 你撞到了不该撞的东西。
lines.en: You bumped what should not be bumped.
Half a step aside, then back.
An arm's length. No more.
You touched me. I am still watching.
A bump means nothing. I carry on.
I stand. I need nothing else.
That is not a pose I can hold.

lines.zh: 我们只是看着，不做别的。
lines.en: We only watch. Nothing more.

lines.zh: 问这个，我会一直看下去。
lines.en: Ask that and I keep staring.
I stand and watch. No company needed.
I stood and thought about that.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢一个人看风景。
lines.en: I prefer watching alone.

lines.zh: 你问完，我还是那个姿势。
lines.en: Ask, and I keep this pose.
Silence is my answer.
Do not say it. It might be heard.

lines.zh: 你弯腰时，我记住了你的背。
lines.en: When you bent down, I memorized your back.
I do not pick it up. I watch it.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，就这么躺着。
lines.en: It simply lies there.
You go back for it. I stay put.
I watched it a long while. It did not move.

lines.zh: 你捡起它，我记住了位置。
lines.en: You picked it up. I noted the spot.
The shadow is longer than the thing.

lines.zh: 我没有手去捡，也不需要有。
lines.en: I do not need hands for that.
You bent over. I saw clearly.

lines.zh: 东西留在原地，更让人不安。
lines.en: Left where it fell. More unsettling.
I have looked long enough.
I moved. For the first time.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就前倾一点。
lines.en: You step back; I lean forward a little.
I shift weight to my front foot.
This time I do more than stand.

lines.zh: 我站了太久，脚陷进土里。
lines.en: I've stood so long my feet sank into soil.
You finally noticed me.
I lift my foot off the ground for the first time.
No rush. I let you come closer.
You are walking now. Good.
Now I watch you move.
I stood long enough.

lines.zh: 你背后那堵墙，我量过距离。
lines.en: I measured the wall behind you.

lines.zh: 我看了三天，只等你转身。
lines.en: I watched three days, waiting for you to turn.
No sound. I simply come.

lines.zh: 我的动作和站着差不多。
lines.en: My move looks much like standing.

lines.zh: 我就站在这里，看你走远。
lines.en: I stand here and watch you leave.
I slid one block closer.
You did not notice I moved.
My eyes follow your hand.

lines.zh: 空气越来越静，你听见了吗？
lines.en: The air goes quiet. Hear it?
You look back more often now.
I am here. Always was.

lines.zh: 静止就是我的全部动作。
lines.en: Standing still is all I ever do.

lines.zh: 你的影子边上多了一条。
lines.en: A second shadow joins yours.

lines.zh: 我沿田埂平移，姿势不变。
lines.en: I slide along the field ridge, posture unchanged.
Two steps. I will not rush.
Wherever your hand goes, I watch.
My pose changes for the first time.
Colder behind you, is it not?
I wait for your breath to slow.
Keep looking at me. Good.
Only two of us in the wood.
A moment more and I am near.
Look up. I am right there.
I will not vanish this time.
I reach and find your shoulder.
As light as my gaze.
A shove. Very cold.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣住你的脉门。
lines.en: My fingers close around your wrist's pulse.
You turn and I am right there.

lines.zh: 我的动作比看着快一点。
lines.en: Faster than watching, a little.

lines.zh: 静止的手，落下时没声音。
lines.en: The still hand falls without a sound.
Your bones creak under my hand.
No blade. My hands are enough.
You fell. I still stand.
I touched the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 我抬手，关节像生锈的门。
lines.en: I raise my arm, joints like a rusted door.
The pain arrives late.
I let go; then you breathe.

lines.zh: 这一下，我只用了一点点力。
lines.en: Only a very little force.

lines.zh: 你又退回到我的视线里。
lines.en: You backed into my line of sight.
You look up and something stands there.
I just took that spot.

lines.zh: 林边多了一个不动的人影。
lines.en: A motionless figure at the treeline.
I watched while you built.
The wind passed. I did not.

lines.zh: 我就站在那条路的尽头。
lines.en: I stand at the end of that path.

lines.zh: 你转身时我第一次出现。
lines.en: I appear the moment you turn.

lines.zh: 天色暗下来，我就在那儿。
lines.en: The light fades, and there I am.
I will not move first.
A distant shape, almost a person.
Did you see me at the window?
I stand in the tree, unnoticed.
Those footsteps were mine too.
I am here, waiting to be found.

lines.zh: 这个位置，我站过很多次。
lines.en: I have stood in this spot often.
The wood gains a little silence.
Three glances, and I stood each time.
I have watched you work the whole time.
No greeting. I only stand.
At the edge of your vision, me.

lines.zh: 火光里，我还是一动不动。
lines.en: In the firelight, I still do not move.
I fall, then rise slowly.
Water to my eyes. I still watch.
After the blast, I return to the spot.
The arrow stays. I do not pull it.

lines.zh: 咒语让我僵了一下，很好。
lines.en: A spell stiffens me. Fine.
I do not eat and do not starve.
Lightning shows me plainly.
As I fall, I am still watching.
